title: Points Already Spent Set Against a Circle Sweep Pool
content:
Points already spent on a Northbeam Circle Membership are set against the pool a sweep would take, and
which spending is counted follows the redemptions on the ledger and the standing of the membership.

## The readings

1. Where one or more redemptions stand in the twelve months ending on the handling day and the membership
   stands active, the points set against the pool are the points spent in that window.
2. Where no redemption stands in that window, a transfer out stands on the ledger and the membership stands
   active, the points set against the pool are the points transferred out over the whole ledger.
3. Where neither of those holds, the points set against the pool are every point spent on the ledger.

## How the three differ

The first reading counts only what was spent in the twelve months ending on the handling day, whatever form
the redemption took. The second counts only the points moved to another profile as a transfer out, over the
whole of the ledger rather than a window of it. The third counts every point ever spent on the ledger, in any
form. A membership that does not stand active always falls to the third reading, because the first two both
require that standing.

## Hypothetical figures

| Redemptions in the 12 months | A transfer out on the ledger | Standing | Points set against the pool |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 redemptions, 900 points spent in the window; 3000 points spent in all | Yes, 400 points | Active | 900 |
| None in the window; 3000 points spent in all | Yes, 400 points | Active | 400 |
| None in the window; 3000 points spent in all | None | Active | 3000 |
| 2 redemptions, 900 points spent in the window; 3000 in all | Yes, 400 points | Lapsed | 3000 |

Whichever reading is taken, what is set against the pool is points spent rather than points earned, and
every figure here is a count of points rather than an amount of money.
